searchText: we have the ability to snapshot the deposit contract tree and export it according to https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4881 few of the checkpoint sync servers serve the deposit tree snapshot along with the state teku also implements it We have the ability to export it but importing a snapshotted deposit tree might be a bit more work. It worked the last time we experimented it but would need to double check for it. Do we know when all ELs are dropping history ? > deposits pre-merge will be generally available for all the consensus clients. how it works is that the actual pre-merge deposits will not be available if ELs drop history. Just the deposit tree is accessible. May 1st is the current time line for dropping pre merge bodies and receipts
